eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Advancements in Computational Sciences (ICACS'27) is the Eighth International Conference, a joint effort by the Faculty of Information Technology, The University of Lahore (UOL) and IEEE Lahore Section. The goal of ICACS'27 is to provide an opportunity for all aspiring researchers, academia representatives, students, industrialists, scientists, professionals, policymakers, investors, and other parties to disseminate their novel ideas and latest research findings in the general areas of Computer Science and Information Technology.
